steps.title: Prepare Washes and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary wash buffers and reconstitute the Proteinase K enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL of isopropanol to the MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 1 concentrate.
Add 30 mL of isopropanol to the MagBead DNA/RNA Wash 2 concentrate.
Reconstitute lyophilized Proteinase K at 20 mg/mL by adding 1.2 mL of Proteinase K Storage Buffer per vial; vortex to dissolve.
Store reconstituted Proteinase K at -20 °C.

steps.title: Pre-make Reagent Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the following plates for the extraction process. Spin all plates down for 1 minute at 12,000 rpm, except for the bead plate which should only receive a quick pulse spin.

substeps.instruction: Pathogen buffer plate: 880 µL Pathogen DNA/RNA buffer in a 1 mL deep well plate.
Bead plate: 25 µL MagBinding beads into a 96V-well PCR plate (prepare <1h before starting).
Wash 1 plate: 550 µL Wash 1 buffer in a 1 mL deep well plate.
Wash 2 plate: 550 µL Wash 2 buffer in a 1 mL deep well plate.
100% ethanol plate: 1 mL 100% ethanol in a 2 mL deep well plate.
80% ethanol plate: 600 µL 80% ethanol in a 1 mL deep well plate.
Water plate A: 50 µL DNAase/RNAse-free water in a 96 V-well PCR plate.
Water plate B: 30 µL DNAase/RNAse-free water in a 96 V-well PCR plate.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Initial Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare samples and begin the lysis process using the Integra workstation.

substeps.instruction: Create a plate map and add 400 µL of samples to a 2 mL deep well plate (Plate 1).
Add 4 µL of Proteinase K into each sample in Plate 1 using a manual multichannel pipet (Note: text also mentions adding 65 µL to 8 well PCR strip tubes).
Load Integra tip set 1.
Program Integra to pipet 250 µL of samples up and down for 1 minute (15 cycles, speed 10).
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes (keep tips).

steps.title: Buffer Addition and Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer and MagBinding beads to the samples.

substeps.instruction: Program Integra to add 800 µL total of Pathogen DNA/RNA Buffer to Plate 1.
Program Integra to mix samples and buffer for 2 minutes (30 cycles, 250 µL, speed 10); keep tips.
Program Integra to mix the MagBinding beads plate (20 µL, 20 cycles) until fully resuspended; pulse spin if beads are not at the bottom.
Program Integra to aspirate 20 µL of beads from the bead plate and transfer to the sample plate.
Program Integra to mix beads with sample for 10 minutes total (5 x 30 cycles, 250 µL, speed 7); keep tips.
Place sample plate on 96-well magnetic stand for 5 minutes until a bead ring forms.

steps.title: Bead Washing
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes to purify the bound nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Program Integra (Manual Pipet 300 µL) to aspirate and discard supernatant into a 2 mL deep well waste plate; discard tips and load new tips.
Remove magnetic stand.
Program Integra to dispense 500 µL Wash 1 into the sample plate; keep tips.
Program Integra to mix beads with Wash 1 for 2 minutes (30 cycles, 250 µL, speed 7); keep tips.
Place on magnetic stand for 2 minutes until bead ring forms.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 300 µL) to aspirate and discard supernatant; keep tips.
Program Integra to dispense 500 µL Wash 2 into the sample plate; keep tips.
Program Integra to mix beads with Wash 2 for 2 minutes (30 cycles, 250 µL, speed 7); keep tips.
Place on magnetic stand for 2 minutes until bead ring forms.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 300 µL) to aspirate and discard supernatant; discard tips and load new tips.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with ethanol and dry them before elution.

substeps.instruction: Remove magnetic stand.
Program Integra to dispense 500 µL 100% Ethanol into the sample plate.
Program Integra to mix beads with ethanol for 2 minutes (30 cycles, 250 µL, speed 7); keep tips.
Place on magnetic stand for 2 minutes until bead ring forms.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 300 µL) to aspirate and discard supernatant.
Remove magnetic stand and repeat the 100% Ethanol wash sequence (dispense, mix, magnet, discard) one more time.
Discard tips after the second ethanol wash and load new tips.
Keep sample plate on the magnetic stand until beads are dry (approximately 10 minutes).

steps.title: TNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the Total Nucleic Acid (TNA) from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Heat Nuclease-free water at 55 °C for 10 minutes.
Program Integra to pipet 33 µL of the heated water into the dried beads and mix for 2 minutes (30 cycles, 33 µL, speed 7); keep tips.
Place on magnetic stand for 2 minutes until bead ring forms.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 30 µL) to transfer 30 µL from the sample plate to a new 96 V-bottom PCR plate.
Store TNA sample immediately at -80 °C.

steps.title: DNase I Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the TNA sample using DNase I.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL of well-mixed SPRI beads into a new 96 V-bottom PCR plate.
Reconstitute lyophilized DNase I by adding 275 µL DNase/RNase-free water and mixing.
Aliquot 20 µL of TNA into a new 96 V-bottom PCR plate.
Prepare DNase master mix (1x reaction = 20 µL sample + 2.5 µL DNase I + 2.5 µL Digestion Buffer).
Using a manual multichannel pipet, aliquot 5 µL of DNase I master mix to each sample and mix.
Program Integra to mix (20 µL, 20 cycles, speed 7).
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Purification and Storage
steps.instruction: Perform a final SPRI bead cleanup to purify the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Program Integra to add 45 µL SPRI beads (1.8x ratio) to the DNase I treated sample and mix (20 cycles, 45 µL, speed 7).
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 2 minutes until bead ring forms.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 100 µL) to aspirate and discard supernatant; keep tips.
Program Integra (Pipet 200 µL) to aspirate and dispense 200 µL of freshly made 80% Ethanol into the sample plate.
Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 200 µL) to aspirate and discard supernatant; keep tips.
Program Integra (Pipet 200 µL) to aspirate and dispense 200 µL of freshly made 80% Ethanol into the sample plate.
Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 200 µL) to aspirate and discard supernatant; discard tips and load new tips.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature until beads are dry.
Remove plate from magnetic stand.
Program Integra to add 22 µL DNase/RNase-free water to each well and mix (10 cycles, 22 µL, speed 7).
Place on magnetic stand for 2 minutes until bead ring forms.
Program Integra (Manual Pipet 20 µL) to aspirate 20 µL of purified TNA sample into a new 96 V-bottom PCR plate.
Store sample at -80 °C immediately.
